rca_inverse_correlation: Brief predicted foreign accumulation (Net Buy Rp29,63 miliar) which typically implies some market support, but the IHSG closed significantly bearish (-2.59%), suggesting that even if there was early foreign buying (Rp413 miliar in session I), it was insufficient to counter broader selling pressure driven by global and geopolitical shocks.
lessons: Ketika IHSG diprediksi Bearish dengan Foreign Flow Accumulation, tetapi Global Market Shock dan Eskalasi Geopolitik Timur Tengah terjadi, maka IHSG ambles -2.59% dan Foreign Flow menjadi Stagnant/Sideways.
Ketika Rupiah diprediksi stabil di tengah tekanan eksternal, tetapi Global Market Shock dan Eskalasi Geopolitik Timur Tengah terjadi, maka Rupiah melemah +0.068% terhadap USD/IDR.
Ketika sektor Industrials dan Energi diprediksi Bullish, tetapi IHSG mengalami penurunan signifikan -2.59% akibat faktor eksternal, maka sektor Industrials naik 0.72% dan sektor Energi naik 0.54%.

Ketika sektor Infrastruktur dan Barang Konsumen Non-Primer diprediksi Bullish, tetapi IHSG mengalami penurunan signifikan -2.59% akibat faktor eksternal, maka sektor Infrastruktur turun dan sektor Barang Konsumen Siklikal turun 0.56%.
summary: The morning brief correctly predicted a bearish IHSG, which closed down 2.59%, but foreign flow was stagnant/sideways instead of accumulated, largely due to unanticipated global market shocks and escalating geopolitical tensions that overshadowed some correctly predicted sector performances.
